messages:
jamie: Quick check — CI canary shows a ~12% tail latency regression after PR #4825 (kernel attention refactor). Repro on a 20k-token sim. Anyone already digging?

ravi: Seen it. Running the local perf-repro now. Initial traces point at the attention KV path; the new memlayout might be thrashing the L2 cache. :thinking_face:

emily: For ownership clarity — kernel attention bits land with runtime-kernel team, KV-cache heuristics owned by runtime-cache. I'll coordinate if we need a patch across both.

oliver: FYI infra rolled a driver update to 520.56 yesterday (infra-ticket #889). Could be a coincident cause. Pinging @infra on the ticket.

mina: Quick datapoint: if I drop microbatch back to 8 locally the 99.9 drops from 420ms → ~240ms. Doesn't prove cause but suggests batching/codepath interaction. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/runtime/perf?panelId=KV-tail

perf-bot: [perf-runner] perf/checker job failed for canary-2026-03-17-20: infra/perf-suite/4825 — regression detected: 12.1% p99 increase vs baseline. Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/4825/trace.zip

jamie: Thanks. Options: (A) rollback PR #4825 from canary, (B) hotfix to kernel to add a feature-flag around the memlayout change, (C) temporary runtime config to reduce microbatching aggressiveness. Which is fastest?

ravi: I can draft a hotfix PR that adds a runtime flag (continuous_batching_index_opt=false) to gate the change. Can target canary and prod rollback if needed. Prefer this so we don't lose other improvements. ETA: PR + smoke by EOD.

emily: I'll schedule rollback window w/ SRE if we need it. If @ravi is confident we can test in canary for 30m and then flip in prod. Also we should run a KV-eviction stress test before flipping.

oliver: I'll attach kernel logs to infra ticket and request driver roll-back validation. If infra confirms driver changed behavior we may need a driver-specific workaround.

mina: Local repro command I used: ```./scripts/perf_repro --model llama-13b --seq 20480 --iters 200 --microbatch 16 --trace true``` — produces similar p99 spike and the trace shows repeated cache-miss bursts in attention_kv_build.

jamie: OK owners: @ravi (hotfix PR), @emily (canary/rollback coordination), @oliver (infra correlation), @mina (repro + trace). Check-ins every 30m until resolved. Add :clock1: to calendar.

perf-bot: Note: test artifacts uploaded, baseline comparison available at https://perf.redwood/internal/compare/4825.

emily: Confirmed with SRE we can do a 30m canary window at 21:30 UTC. If p99 improves revert plan will be aborted; else we roll back at 22:10.

ravi: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/runtime/pull/4892 — adds flag and a canary-only rollout. Running smoke jobs now. Will post results. :thumbsup:

mina: I'll run the microbatch sweep (8/12/16) and post numbers in this thread once done.

jamie: Appreciate it. Keep updates short here. If anything blocks please call in #eng-oncall.

emily: Added the rollback playbook to the ticket and CC'd SRE.

ravi: Smoke looks good on local canary sim — no tail spike with flag off. Pushing canary build now.

jamie: Great — will watch the canary dashboard. Thanks everyone.
